name: owusuboateng-me
description: Source for owusuboateng.me. The site is static; this only bundles the scripts and styles it serves itself.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:techy
scripts.build:techy: tailwindcss -i src/techy.css -o assets/css/techy.css --minify && mkdir -p assets/js/vendor && cp node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js node_modules/gsap/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js assets/js/vendor/
